label: Taula Llarga, Catalan restaurant
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400..700;1,9..144,400..600&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Caveat:wght@500;700&display=swap');
  /* Taula Llarga: a Catalan restaurant in Hamburg-Ottensen built around one long table. Full-width bands on a 78rem
     grid: the hero, the menu with its allergen legend, tonight's board, the booking, the long table, the gallery, the
     guest book and the visit. Fraunces over Manrope, the board in Caveat. */
  #in-restaurant {
    --background: oklch(0.972 0.014 75);
    --foreground: oklch(0.25 0.03 40);
    --card: oklch(0.99 0.008 75);
    --card-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --popover: oklch(0.99 0.008 75);
    --popover-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --muted: oklch(0.94 0.018 70);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.46 0.035 45);
    --border: oklch(0.25 0.03 40 / 0.14);
    --input: oklch(0.25 0.03 40 / 0.3);
    --primary: oklch(0.52 0.15 38);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.01 75);
    --secondary: oklch(0.925 0.035 55);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.3 0.06 38);
    --accent: oklch(0.935 0.022 65);
    --accent-foreground: var(--foreground);
    --ring: var(--primary);
    --radius: 0.5rem;
    --radius-sm: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 4px));
    --radius-md: max(0px, calc(var(--radius) - 2px));
    --radius-lg: var(--radius);
    --radius-xl: calc(var(--radius) + 4px);
    --tl-band: oklch(0.945 0.022 68);
    --tl-board: oklch(0.29 0.035 165);
    --tl-board-ink: oklch(0.95 0.012 95);
    --tl-board-frame: oklch(0.45 0.06 55);
    --tl-mark: oklch(0.55 0.16 38);
    --tl-ticket: oklch(0.995 0.004 95);
    --tl-ticket-ink: oklch(0.25 0.03 40);
    --tl-head: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif;
    --tl-hand: 'Caveat', 'Segoe Print', cursive;
    --tl-gutter: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
    color-scheme: light;
    container: in-restaurant / inline-size;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow-x: clip;
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
    font:
      400 1rem/1.6 'Manrope',
      var(--font-sans);
  }
  #in-restaurant[data-look='candle'] {
    --background: oklch(0.962 0.014 25);
    --foreground: oklch(0.22 0.045 18);
    --card: oklch(0.985 0.008 25);
    --popover: oklch(0.985 0.008 25);
    --muted: oklch(0.93 0.02 22);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.45 0.05 20);
    --border: oklch(0.22 0.045 18 / 0.15);
    --input: oklch(0.22 0.045 18 / 0.3);
    --primary: oklch(0.4 0.13 20);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.97 0.02 80);
    --secondary: oklch(0.92 0.035 80);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.32 0.06 60);
    --accent: oklch(0.925 0.022 25);
    --radius: 0.25rem;
    --tl-band: oklch(0.935 0.02 22);
    --tl-board: oklch(0.2 0.035 18);
    --tl-board-ink: oklch(0.86 0.1 85);
    --tl-board-frame: oklch(0.72 0.11 80);
    --tl-mark: oklch(0.6 0.12 75);
    --tl-ticket: oklch(0.985 0.01 80);
    --tl-ticket-ink: oklch(0.22 0.045 18);
  }
  #in-restaurant[data-look='terrace'] {
    --background: oklch(0.985 0.005 230);
    --foreground: oklch(0.26 0.05 250);
    --card: oklch(1 0 0);
    --popover: oklch(1 0 0);
    --muted: oklch(0.955 0.012 230);
    --muted-foreground: oklch(0.47 0.04 250);
    --border: oklch(0.26 0.05 250 / 0.13);
    --input: oklch(0.26 0.05 250 / 0.28);
    --primary: oklch(0.47 0.13 250);
    --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0.005 230);
    --secondary: oklch(0.94 0.035 115);
    --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.34 0.07 120);
    --accent: oklch(0.95 0.015 235);
    --radius: 1rem;
    --tl-band: oklch(0.955 0.022 110);
    --tl-board: oklch(0.995 0.004 95);
    --tl-board-ink: oklch(0.3 0.08 255);
    --tl-board-frame: oklch(0.88 0.07 85 / 0.85);
    --tl-mark: oklch(0.55 0.14 250);
    --tl-ticket: oklch(1 0 0);
    --tl-ticket-ink: oklch(0.26 0.05 250);
  }
  #in-restaurant [hidden] {
    display: none !important;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-look-only {
    display: none;
  }
  #in-restaurant[data-look='terracotta'] .tl-look-only[data-for='terracotta'],
  #in-restaurant[data-look='candle'] .tl-look-only[data-for='candle'],
  #in-restaurant[data-look='terrace'] .tl-look-only[data-for='terrace'] {
    display: block;
  }
  #in-restaurant :is(h1, h2, h3) {
    font-family: var(--tl-head);
    font-optical-sizing: auto;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-party-hint a {
    color: var(--primary);
    font-weight: 600;
    text-underline-offset: 0.2em;
  }
  #in-restaurant :is(a, button, summary, input, select, textarea):focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  /* the grid: every band is full width, its content on one 78rem column */
  #in-restaurant > .tl-band {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding: clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 6rem) max(var(--tl-gutter), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
  }
  #in-restaurant > .tl-band[data-tone='alt'] {
    background: var(--tl-band);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-eyebrow {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--primary);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-restaurant .mk-section-header {
    max-width: none;
    margin-block-end: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
    padding-inline: 0;
  }
  #in-restaurant .mk-section-header-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 1.4rem + 1.8vw, 2.75rem);
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  }
  #in-restaurant .mk-section-header-desc {
    max-width: 40rem;
  }
  /* the header: the name, five places on the page, the look and the mode, the booking */
  #in-restaurant .tl-header {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding-inline: max(var(--tl-gutter), calc((100% - 78rem) / 2));
    border-block-end: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 90%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-header .mk-header-inner {
    max-width: none;
    min-height: 4.75rem;
    padding: 0.75rem 0;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-brand {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.1rem;
    color: var(--foreground);
    text-decoration: none;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-brand b {
    font: 600 1.5rem/1 var(--tl-head);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-brand small {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-restaurant .mk-header-nav .nav-menu-link {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  #in-restaurant .mk-header-nav .nav-menu-link[aria-current] {
    box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary);
    border-radius: 0;
  }
  #in-restaurant .mk-header-actions .select {
    width: auto;
  }
  #in-restaurant .site-mode {
    flex: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--background);
    color: var(--foreground);
  }
  #in-restaurant .site-mode:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 66rem) {
    #in-restaurant .mk-header-nav {
      display: none;
    }
    #in-restaurant .mk-header-menu {
      display: inline-flex;
    }
  }
  @container mk-header (max-width: 30rem) {
    #in-restaurant .tl-brand small {
      display: none;
    }
  }
  /* the trim under the header: tiles, a brass rule or the terrace's awning */
  #in-restaurant .tl-trim {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0 0 auto;
    height: 0.875rem;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-trim[data-for='terracotta'] {
    background: conic-gradient(from 45deg, var(--tl-mark) 25%, transparent 0 50%, var(--tl-mark) 0 75%, transparent 0) 0
      0 / 0.875rem 0.875rem;
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-trim[data-for='candle'] {
    height: 0.5rem;
    border-block: 1px solid var(--tl-board-frame);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-trim[data-for='terrace'] {
    height: 1.4rem;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary) 0 1.75rem, oklch(0.95 0.035 95) 1.75rem 3.5rem);
    mask:
      radial-gradient(0.9rem 0.6rem at 50% 0.8rem, #000 98%, transparent) 0 0 / 1.75rem 100% repeat-x,
      linear-gradient(#000, #000) 0 0 / 100% 0.8rem no-repeat;
  }
  /* the hero: the promise, the long table circled, the worktop with a dish on it */
  #in-restaurant .tl-hero {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
    padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 5.5rem);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-hero h1 {
    margin: 1rem 0 1.25rem;
    font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 1.6rem + 3.6vw, 4.6rem);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.02;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-marked {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    font-style: italic;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-mark {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -30% -14% -30% -14%;
    width: 128%;
    height: 160%;
    overflow: visible;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-mark path {
    fill: none;
    stroke: var(--tl-mark);
    stroke-width: 3;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-dasharray: 1;
    stroke-dashoffset: 1;
    animation: tl-draw 1.3s 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.6, 0, 0.3, 1) forwards;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-mark[data-for='candle'] path {
    stroke-width: 2;
  }
  @keyframes tl-draw {
    to {
      stroke-dashoffset: 0;
    }
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-lead {
    max-width: 36rem;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    line-height: 1.65;
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-actions {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin-block-start: 2rem;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-facts {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, auto));
    justify-content: start;
    gap: 0.5rem 2.25rem;
    margin: 2.5rem 0 0;
    padding-block-start: 1.25rem;
    border-block-start: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-facts dt {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-facts dd {
    margin: 0.2rem 0 0;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-hero-pic {
    position: relative;
    margin: 0;
    padding-inline-start: 2.5rem;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-hero-pic > img:first-child {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-hero-dish {
    position: absolute;
    inset: auto auto -1.5rem 0;
    width: 42%;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    border: 0.5rem solid var(--background);
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
    rotate: -8deg;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -20px oklch(0.2 0.03 40 / 0.55);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-hero-pic figcaption {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 1rem 1rem auto auto;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: oklch(0.15 0.02 40 / 0.65);
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  /* the menu: tabs by service, dishes with their allergen codes, the legend that filters them */
  #in-restaurant .tl-menu {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 19rem;
    align-items: start;
    gap: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-menu .tab-list {
    margin-block-end: 1.5rem;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-menu .tab-content {
    outline-offset: 4px;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-service {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.25rem 1rem;
    margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
    padding: 0.875rem 1.125rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-service b {
    font: 500 1.125rem/1.3 var(--tl-head);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-service span {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-course {
    margin: 1.75rem 0 0.5rem;
    color: var(--primary);
    font: italic 500 1.25rem/1.2 var(--tl-head);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-course:first-child {
    margin-block-start: 0;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-dishes {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-dish {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 0.15rem 1.25rem;
    padding-block: 0.8rem;
    border-block-end: 1px dashed var(--border);
    transition: opacity 0.25s;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-dish h4 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-dish h4 svg {
    width: 0.95rem;
    height: 0.95rem;
    margin-inline-start: 0.35rem;
    vertical-align: -0.1em;
    color: oklch(0.55 0.13 145);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-dish p {
    grid-column: 1;
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-dish .tl-codes {
    grid-row: 1;
    grid-column: 2;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-dish .tl-price {
    grid-row: 1;
    grid-column: 3;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-codes {
    display: inline-flex;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-codes abbr {
    display: inline-grid;
    place-items: center;
    min-width: 1.35rem;
    height: 1.35rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: 999px;
    text-decoration: none;
    cursor: help;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-dish[data-soon] :is(h4, .tl-price) {
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
  }
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-a:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='A'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-b:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='B'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-c:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='C'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-d:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='D'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-e:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='E'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-f:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='F'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-g:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='G'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-h:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='H'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-l:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='L'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-m:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='M'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-n:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='N'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-o:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='O'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-p:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='P'],
  #in-restaurant:has(#tl-al-r:checked) .tl-dish[data-al~='R'] {
    opacity: 0.3;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-legend {
    position: sticky;
    top: 6rem;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.875rem;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--card);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-legend fieldset {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-legend legend {
    margin-block-end: 0.25rem;
    padding: 0;
    font: 500 1.125rem/1.3 var(--tl-head);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-legend-hint,
  #in-restaurant .tl-legend output,
  #in-restaurant .tl-legend small {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--muted-foreground);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-legend output {
    display: block;
    color: var(--foreground);
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-allergens {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-allergens label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.45rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.4rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-allergens label:hover {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--accent-foreground);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-allergens b {
    display: inline-grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 1.35rem;
    height: 1.35rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--input);
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-allergens label:has(:checked) b {
    border-color: var(--primary);
    background: var(--primary);
    color: var(--primary-foreground);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-allergens input {
    position: absolute;
    opacity: 0;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-allergens label:has(:focus-visible) {
    outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
    outline-offset: 1px;
  }
  /* tonight: the board, slanted, beside the kitchen's note */
  #in-restaurant .tl-tonight {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-board {
    position: relative;
    padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
    border: 0.75rem solid var(--tl-board-frame);
    border-radius: 0.375rem;
    background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 30% 20%, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.07), transparent 60%), var(--tl-board);
    color: var(--tl-board-ink);
    box-shadow: 0 30px 50px -30px oklch(0.15 0.02 40 / 0.6);
    rotate: -1.8deg;
    font-family: var(--tl-hand);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-board h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font: 700 clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.2rem)/1 var(--tl-hand);
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-board-date {
    margin: 0.25rem 0 1.25rem;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
    opacity: 0.85;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-board ul {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.9rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-board li {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0 1rem;
    font-size: 1.55rem;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-board li small {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    opacity: 0.8;
  }
  #in-restaurant .tl-board-note {
    margin: 1.5rem 0 0;
    padding-block-start: 1rem;
    border-block-start: 2px dashed currentColor;
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  #in-restaurant[data-look='candle'] .tl-board {
    border: 1px solid var(--tl-board-frame);
    border-radius: 2px;
    outline: 1px solid var(--tl-board-frame);
    outline-offset: -0.6rem;
    background: var(--tl-board);
    rotate: 1.4deg;
    font-family: var(--tl-head);
    font-style: italic;
  }
  #in-restaurant[data-look='candle'] .tl-board h2 {
